claim: On the full Hyperliquid native-perp cross-section, a funding-conditioned score carries information about the RELATIVE ordering of next-24h observed liquidation intensity across coins (cross-sectional rank IC and top-minus-bottom spread).

cannot: override, soften, or re-label any sealed time-series P2 verdict (H_tracka_hl_liquidation_forecast NOT_MET, H_tracka_hl_early_liquidation_forecast INCONCLUSIVE_PILOT_SHORTFALL, H_trackb_modeled_breaches NOT_SUPPORTED, the 19.04% expansion PASS which remains NOT PROMOTABLE)
status_contract.rationale: The estimand differs from every sealed P2 design (cross-sectional ranking, not per-coin time-series QLIKE), and the evaluation window is already open, so 17 promotion conditions 2/4/7 cannot be satisfied.

sealed_p2_designs: TRACKA-HL-EARLY4H-2025H1 — 9 coins, 2025-05-25..2025-10-31, per-coin 24h QLIKE — NOT_MET (robust estimator)
TRACKA-HL-EXPANSION-20261111T195500Z — 8 coins, 2026-05..2026-10 — 19.04% PASS, not promotable (LOIO 4/8, placebo p=0.142)
why_this_is_new.what_is_different: All of the above are per-coin time-series intensity forecasts on small hand-picked universes (8-9 coins). This arm scores the FULL native-perp cross-section (all markets with adequate observed label coverage, ~150-200 coins) on a ranking metric, which is a different estimand and a different universe arm, and which has never been evaluated in this repository.
why_this_is_new.label_window_note: There is no unopened label window left inside 2025-05-25..2026-10-31 (2025-05..2025-10 and 2025-11..2026-04 and 2026-05..2026-10 have all been opened). This arm is therefore explicitly exploratory and is not a substitute for confirmatory P2 evidence.

acquisition.policy: cache-first, provenance sidecars, fail-closed schema, no workflow edits

universe.selection_rule: coverage-only, frozen ex ante, before any outcome: native perps (market endswith '-PERP', no ':') with >=20 observed liquidation-days AND >=100 observed liquidation events AND complete hourly candle+funding coverage over 2025-10-08..2026-01-17.
universe.selection_outcome_definition: Only label EXISTENCE/coverage counts are used for eligibility (an event-adequacy rule identical in kind to the frozen expansion prereg). No liquidation magnitude, direction, timing, or forecast result informs selection.
universe.note: This is a full-cross-section universe arm. It does not reuse the sealed 8/9-coin panels.

targets.definition: Observed ironflow liquidation event count in the next 24h UTC bucket for that coin. Observed only; never modeled or synthetic.
Observed ironflow liquidation notional USD in the next 24h UTC bucket.

features_causal.rule: All features use only data at or before the bucket start. Hourly series are aggregated to the decision bucket with backward-looking as-of merges only.
features_causal.rv24h: trailing 24h realized variance from hourly closes ending at bucket start
features_causal.funding_rate: latest settled fundingRate at or before bucket start
features_causal.premium: latest settled premium at or before bucket start
features_causal.score: Funding-conditioned cross-sectional score: cross-sectional z-score of funding_rate plus cross-sectional z-score of abs_funding, computed WITHIN each 24h bucket across the eligible universe. No time-series fitting, no leakage across buckets.

estimand.primary: Spearman rank correlation between the cross-sectional funding score at bucket t and next-24h observed liquidation event count at t+1, computed per 30-day test block on the pooled cross-section.
estimand.secondary: Top-k minus bottom-k mean next-24h liquidation notional spread (k = 10% of the universe, floor 5), per block.
estimand.aggregation: Mean IC across blocks with a block-level t-style summary; the unit of inference is the 30-day block, not the coin-day.

inference.null: Within each 24h bucket, permute the funding score across coins (breaks any coin-funder mapping while preserving the cross-sectional score distribution).
inference.materiality_floor: |mean IC| >= 0.05 AND top-minus-bottom spread sign consistent across >=2 of 3 blocks
inference.uncertainty: Report the permutation null 5th/95th percentiles and the empirical p-value per block and pooled.

splits.method: chronological, 7-day embargo between blocks, no random split

burn_in.role: feature warm-up and universe eligibility only; never scored

splits.note: Identical block skeleton to Arm A so the two arms are comparable, but the arms are scored and reported separately.

decision_rule.EXPLORATORY_SIGNAL: materiality + permutation criteria met -> report as EXPLORATORY_ONLY signal with full diagnostics; do NOT promote; a future CONFIRMATORY design would require a newly preregistered, unopened forward window
decision_rule.EXPLORATORY_NULL: criteria not met -> preserve the null with exact failing minima
decision_rule.INADMISSIBLE: universe < 5 coins or < 3 blocks with data -> emit infeasibility with exact minima and stop

forbidden: Any claim of promotion, confirmation, or status change for any sealed hypothesis
Reading or scoring 2026-05-01..2026-10-31 (sealed holdout of the closed P2/volatility designs)
Using liquidation labels inside Arm A
Venue mixing (Binance/2024 or any non-Hyperliquid liquidation data)
Tuning the score, k, or materiality floor against test blocks
Committing raw parquet objects or caches
gate_4_note: Gate 4 Branch 1 remains EXTERNAL_BLOCKED and is not a blocker for Arm B.
